core_conclusion: Show the actual restoration appearance and full-image scores of available denoisers on four fixed noisy inputs without asserting that one model wins every example.
reuse_level: style-only inheritance from the user-provided qualitative comparison layout

evidence_chain.row1: CBSD68 fixed example with Gaussian noise
evidence_chain.row2: McMaster fixed example with spatial Gaussian noise
evidence_chain.row3: Kodak24 fixed example with Poisson noise
evidence_chain.row4: Urban100 fixed example with the existing Gaussian multiplicative Speckle extension

mapping.images: restored_zoom.png, clean_zoom.png and noisy_display_clipped_zoom.png at the same display_protocol.json ROI
mapping.metrics: PSNR and SSIM for each whole evaluated image from selected_rows.json or inference metrics.json
mapping.replicates: B0 and G1 training seed 0; one public pretrained checkpoint per external method
mapping.uncertainty: None: individual image outputs, not multi-seed averages or statistical estimates

image_integrity.noisy_display_clipping: [0,1] for display only; inference consumes common original noisy float input
image_integrity.missing_data: Fail if any required image or score file is absent; never insert fabricated data

exclusions.reason: Matching pretrained weights unavailable; no substitute images permitted

interpretation_limits: Public pretrained models may differ from the exact Table I training setup
Speckle row retains the earlier Gaussian multiplicative extension protocol
